title: cyperus oblongus
intro: Cyperus oblongus, commonly known as Galingale or Nutgrass, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is native to Africa and Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Cyperus oblongus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and protect against certain diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-diarrheal effects.
